page.notes: Two reference marks (∗) stand in the text after "Quem" and "quo"; their marginal notes are not visible on this scan, so none are transcribed. The first word "vare" is a fragment continuing from the previous page and is kept as printed. "dominibitur" is read as printed and may be doubtful. "tibi:" is printed with a colon-like mark. The Greek word αὐτοκράτως is transcribed as printed. The right margin is cropped; any notes there could not be read.
